seo.title: About
seo.description: About Arafat Bin Wahahid, fuel attendant at Oman Oil (OQ) in Dhofar and freelance graphic designer.

image.alt: Arafat in his blue Oman Oil uniform on duty at a fuel pump

paragraphs: I have worked in fuel station operations at Oman Oil (OQ) for three years. My day covers safe fueling, HSE rules, supervising shifts, and keeping the station clean and running.
I train new attendants, handle cash and invoicing, and report safety issues early. I want to grow into a Foreman role, where I can lead a team and improve how the station performs.

Outside the forecourt I work with Microsoft Excel and Word, and I design logos and social media graphics in Photoshop and Illustrator. That mix lets me handle reports and paperwork as well as customers and pumps.
